question: When copies of a knot are joined in a ring through witness distinctions and the witnesses are forgotten, is the composite on the remaining distinctions constrained, and which excluded patterns does it keep?

definitions.knot: a Boolean relation on at least three variables whose excluded states form a nonempty set with no two states at Hamming distance one (K1-K3 under the forgetting reading)
definitions.placement: a knot with an ordered pair of its variables chosen as witness in and witness out; the others are its middle distinctions
definitions.transfer: for one value m of the middle distinctions, the 2x2 table of allowed (witness in, witness out) pairs
definitions.ring: k copies of placements; copy i's witness out is copy i+1's witness in, indices mod k; the composite allows a middle pattern when some witness assignment satisfies every copy, and the witnesses are forgotten
definitions.chain: k copies joined the same way without closing; the two end witnesses are kept as distinctions of the composite
definitions.classes: free (nothing excluded); knot (at least three variables, excluded set nonempty with no two excluded patterns adjacent); small (constrained, fewer than three variables, no two excluded adjacent); contradiction (everything excluded); other (constrained with two adjacent excluded patterns)

public_inputs.knots: all knots on three variables (34) and on four variables (742), enumerated from their definition
public_inputs.placements: every ordered witness pair: 6 per three-variable knot, 12 per four-variable knot
public_inputs.ring_lengths: k = 1..8 for three-variable knots; k = 1..6 for four-variable knots
public_inputs.mixed_rings: every ordered pair of distinct three-variable placements, alternating, k = 2 and 4
public_inputs.holes: reduced GF(2) homology of the composite's shape (free sets) when it has at most 8 variables

forbidden_inputs: the predicted classes or excluded sets as inputs to the producer's classification

predictions.P2: a ring excludes a middle pattern exactly when every transfer along it is a permutation and an odd number of them are the swap
predictions.P3: a placement keeps every ring constrained (k = 1..max) exactly when all its transfers are permutations, exactly when the knot is a parity relation
predictions.P4: three-variable placements split 12 (every ring constrained) / 36 (constrained exactly at odd k) / 156 (never constrained)
predictions.P5: chain composites are knots or free (KNOT-FOUNDATION-20261019-001D composition), so chains keep constraints that rings of the same placement can lose

primary_observable: per placement and k: composite class, excluded-set size, agreement of the excluded set with P2; per placement: the set of k at which rings are constrained
cheapest_meaningful_control: (1) the composite is computed two ways: by brute force over witness assignments for k <= 3, and by composing transfer tables for every k; the two must agree. (2) A relation that is not a knot (two adjacent excluded states) used as a link must be able to yield 'other'. (3) The contradiction class must be reachable: a link that forbids every pair for some middle value. (4) The prediction with 'even' in place of 'odd' must fail.
independent_check: check_result.py recomputes composites and classes with separate code and confirms every knot verdict with knotlab's check_knot and homology
decision_or_followup_rule: A signal is P1-P4 holding on every case and P5 holding on every chain. A signal supports the ring theorem of ticket B, which carries the proof; a mismatch is reported as a counterexample to the theory and stops ticket B until it is understood.
first_executable_signal: three-variable rings at k = 1..8, then four-variable rings, then chains and mixed rings
stop_rule: Stop after the declared roster; stop early only on a classifier or control failure.
nonclaims: Finite enumeration on the declared knots, placements and lengths only; the general statement is ticket B's proof.
Boolean distinctions only; many-valued knots are ticket C.
One witness passed between neighbouring copies; networks with several loops are ticket C.
No claim about native loops, space, distance or physics.
